system.description: You create a burst of fire within long range, filling an immediate area. Roll against each creature in the area; you inflict 3 damage on a success, or 1 damage on a failure. Flammable objects may catch fire. Each level of Effort applied to increase damage adds 2 damage to each target (instead of 3). Action.
